Hi Emily / Rajiv,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to get the evaluation moving. I wanted to introduce the Redwood team who will support the evaluation and the security intake:

- Karthik Iyer — Account Executive (me) — primary contact for timeline and commercial questions
- Marissa Cole — Customer Success (onboarding & trial operations)
- Vivek Kulkarni — Head of Security (GRC, SOC 2 coordination)
- Laura Bennett — Security Program Manager (evidence collection / vetting)

To keep things tight, we typically run a short mutual action plan (MAP) that covers:
1) Evidence & compliance review (SOC 2, subprocessor list, data flows)
2) Trial access to a scoped environment for integration testing
3) Legal & procurement (DPA, SOW, PO)
4) Final evaluation / go‑no‑go and close (PO / contract signature)

Proposed kickoff milestones (draft):
- Week 1 (Aug 3–7): Evidence review & vendor portal access
- Week 2 (Aug 10–14): Scoped trial + smoke tests
- Week 3 (Aug 17–21): Procurement redlines & close decision

Could you confirm: 1) the right security/compliance contact at Stellar for evidence requests, 2) your preferred deadline for a signed SOW/PO, and 3) any major blockers (procurement windows, legal review cycles) we should plan around?

I attached an evidence-request-template to make the first pass quicker — feel free to return partial artifacts, we can iterate. Once I have your security contact, Laura will follow up with a short list of the specific artifacts we need and suggested transfer mechanisms (secure portal / SFTP).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,

Rajiv / Emily — thanks for confirming. A couple of operational notes to help make the evidence review quick: 

1) Preferred transfer: secure vendor portal (we'll provide a one-time upload link) — SFTP works if you require a managed transfer; avoid unencrypted email attachments.
2) Required artifacts (short list): SOC 2 Type II report (PDF), system description, subprocessor list, data flow diagram for PHI/PII if applicable, encryption details, latest penetration test summary.
3) Evidence packaging: a single zipped package with an index (we attached our evidence-index.xlsx) helps us map documents quickly.

Attachments included: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary of our controls and scope), evidence-index.xlsx (fillable index for vendor artifacts), data-processing-addendum.pdf (draft DPA language). If you prefer, we can redact sensitive portions of the SOC 2 on request and sign an NDA for additional detail.

One ask for integration testing: please identify a non-production dataset or scrubbed sample that mirrors your expected usage patterns (record volumes, typical prompt/query types). We won't accept or process live PHI in the trial without a signed DPA and approved environment controls.

Next steps: Laura will send the one-time portal link and a short checklist; Marissa will follow up to book the smoke-test window once the trial env is ready. If you can aim to drop artifacts by Aug 7, we should be in a good place to keep the timeline above.

-Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Security, Redwood Inference
